item.text:
No additional defect was confirmed in this pass. Remaining unexplored leader-election behaviors require duplicated or spoofed network traffic, which falls outside the stated crash-fault assumptions rather than providing a concrete supported-input failure.

The audit remains at 28 confirmed findings. Highest-impact issues remain:

- LFU cache resynchronization causing replica value divergence,
- delta-snapshot synchronization corruption,
- decided-index regression during `AcceptSync`,
- persistent failed-write leakage and destructive suffix replacement,
- timeout retry duplication,
- LRU bincode deserialization failure.

All evidence and reproduction artifacts are documented in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
